title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Bantayan in the Municipality of Lingayen, Province of Pangasinan, Into a Barrio of Said Municipality, to Be Known as the Barrio of Bantayan
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Bantayan in the Municipality of Lingayen, Province of Pangasinan, Into a Barrio of Said Municipality, to Be Known as the Barrio of Bantayan
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Bantayan thành Barrio Bantayan tại Đô thị Lingayen, Tỉnh Pangasinan, Barrio Said Municipality
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Bantayan เป็น บาริโอ Bantayan ในเทศบาล Lingayen จังหวัด Pangasinan บารังไกย์ Said Municipality
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sitio Bantayan menjadi Barrio Bantayan di Kotamadya Lingayen, Provinsi Pangasinan, Barrio Said Municipality
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Bantayan kepada Barrio Bantayan di Perbandaran Lingayen, Wilayah Pangasinan, Barrio Said Municipality

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5559_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Bantayan in the Municipality of Lingayen, Province of Pangasinan, is converted into a barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Bantayan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
